recap.text: Jamal, a seventeen-foot shark who now breathes air and cannot fly, hops a little and breaks his third harness of eight double-jointed spider legs, because Carl is out of extra-large leg joints. Katia says the bomb ruined the fifth set, which had no shielding at the edge of the No Disassemble's pulse. Jamal swipes Tuba's spear away with one leg, leaving her bleeding, then bounces on a new set Mordecai holds.

Jamal practises brushing Donut and Carl with the new grabbers Mordecai designed for his front legs, which make his spider legs look like hands, and Donut tells him to be gentle but firm. Jamal then climbs onto the ceiling to test his new sticky feet, gets stuck, and says he wishes he could go back to the ocean. In the wrecked arena, he lies smashed against the far wall with his legs fallen off, alive.

beats.headline: Three hops, three harnesses
beats.text: Behind Carl in the forest, Jamal apologizes: he did a little hop, and the metal pieces broke again. It is the third harness Carl has hastily built him, like the conveyance Katia built for Tran but much bigger: eight double-jointed legs and a harness for the seventeen-foot shark, who now breathes air and, no longer one of Signet's paper tattoos, cannot fly. It makes him look like a horrifying spider hybrid. Carl's prototype takes spoken orders; Katia's version is to read his thoughts. The joints can handle the jump but not the landing, and Carl is out of extra-large leg joints. Jamal must wait for Katia.
beats.gist: Carl builds Jamal a third harness, eight spider legs for the shark, but his hop breaks it.

beats.headline: Broken again
beats.text: Donut's message from the base, all in capitals, runs through the news: the new wall is coming along nicely, they have painted the castle pink, and Jamal broke his new legs again. Justice Light says he can fix them without going into the saferoom. Katia and Li Na are almost done with the clock tower, and Katia is on her way to Carl.
beats.gist: Donut's all-caps message reports the pink castle and that Jamal broke his new legs again.

beats.headline: A spear swiped away
beats.text: Jamal hops in circles round two terrified crawlers, Selvi and Tuba, while Bigs ties them up. Carl had ordered the shark and the slug not to hurt them, but Tuba bleeds profusely from a wound in her side: Jamal was forced to swipe her spear away with one of his mechanical legs. Neither woman can be healed, a side effect of refusing to fight while under Conscription.
beats.gist: Jamal swipes Tuba's spear away with a mechanical leg while Bigs ties up Tuba and Selvi.

beats.headline: The fifth set
beats.text: Jamal flops along behind the group, complaining loudly: these were the fifth set of legs he has been given, and he was led to believe they were top quality. Katia calls over her shoulder that the bomb ruined the cybernetics, and not only his; there are more in the saferoom. Jamal has seen the ones in her workshop, and they are much too small for him. Don't worry, Katia says: she made another set for him, and Mordecai has it. Carl tells Donut the legs failed because they were not shielded, on the very edge of the No Disassemble's pulse.
beats.gist: Jamal complains about his fifth set of legs; Katia blames the bomb and says Mordecai has another set.

beats.headline: A new set
beats.text: Jamal stayed in the saferoom through the Zerzura, and he is one of the few NPCs who have decided to stay with Carl and Donut. Now he bounces up and down on a new set of legs, very excited at the thought of seeing a goddess like Eileithyia, who he has heard is quite beautiful, though not as beautiful as her retainer, Yemaya.
beats.gist: Jamal bounces on his new legs, excited to see the goddess Eileithyia.

beats.headline: Hands on the front legs
beats.text: Donut tells Jamal he is not hacking down a tree: gentle but firm. He is practising with the new grabbers on his front legs, designed by Mordecai, which make his front spider legs look like they have hands and him look even more terrifying. He holds one brush in each, one on Donut and the screaming one on Carl, both of which give them their daily buffs, and he brushes them inexpertly.
beats.gist: Jamal practises brushing Donut and Carl with Mordecai's new hand-like grabbers while Donut coaches him.

beats.headline: Stuck on the ceiling
beats.text: Jamal is up on the ceiling. He wanted to see whether he could walk upside down with his new and improved sticky feet, and now, he apologizes, he finds himself in quite the inverted conundrum. He is stuck, and has been for quite a bit. Then, talking fast and sad, he says he is happy to have his legs, but he wishes he could just go back to the ocean, and he came up there so he could see everything all at once.
beats.gist: Jamal gets stuck on the ceiling testing his sticky feet and says he misses the ocean.

beats.headline: Smashed against the wall
beats.text: In the wreck of the arena, Imani calls for everyone to check in. The RV is broken in half, and the Tigran APV lies on its side. Mongo stands shaking his head, Rend is on his feet, and Gonk hides behind Simoom. Jamal is smashed against the far wall, his legs absolutely wrecked and fallen off him. But he is alive.
beats.gist: Jamal is smashed against the far wall with his legs wrecked and fallen off, but he is alive.
